files.text:
# Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.2

100 × 100 mm, 2 layers, all parts on top. Made with KiCad 7 + Freerouting (FOSS). DRC: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 unconnected.
**Every BOM line has an LCSC number → JLCPCB assembles the whole board (SMD + the clamps, sockets and fan header). You only plug in the DevKitC.**

**New in v1.2**
| Change | Detail |
|---|---|
| Clamps assembled | WAGO 804 (not at LCSC) → Cixi Kefa **KF250-3.5** spring clamps (push button, 45° wire entry, 0.2–0.75 mm², 5 A), 2P/3P/4P/6P all in stock at LCSC |
| LEAK clamp (J13) | Water probe on the cabinet floor: pulsed 3.3 V (no corrosion), ADC on IO35, clamp diode. HA: "Water leak", "Leak probe" |
| VALVE clamp (J14) | 12 V low-side switch (AO3400A, SS34 flyback, PTC 1.5 A) for a water valve. A leak powers it automatically. HA: "Water valve" |
| Buzzer (BZ1) | MLT-8530 on 5 V, driven by IO15 (rtttl). Leak alarm beeps even with the "Buzzer" switch off |
| 12 V monitor | 100k/22k divider on VP (IO36). HA: "12 V rail", "Supply voltage low" (< 10.5 V) |
| DevKit sockets | Three 1×19 sockets: J3 + J4 (25.4 mm row spacing) or J3 + J15 (22.86 mm). Both pitches fit, no measuring |
| JLC requests | 3 tooling holes Ø1.152 mm (TH1–TH3, corners), pin-1 dots on all ICs / transistors / diodes, rotation rule for SOT-23 fixed |

## Files
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `robo-garage_gerbers_JLCPCB.zip` | Upload at JLCPCB (PCB) |
| `robo-garage_BOM_JLCPCB.csv`, `robo-garage_CPL_JLCPCB.csv` | PCB Assembly: BOM + pick & place (45 lines, 108 parts) |
| `pin1-check.png` | Intended orientation of every polarised part: compare with JLC's placement preview |
| `robo-garage-pcb.yaml` | ESPHome config for this board |
| `kicad/` | KiCad project to edit later |
| `render_top.png`, `render_bottom.png` | Pictures |

## Order at JLCPCB
| Step | Setting |
|---|---|
| 1 PCB | Upload the gerbers zip → 2 layers, 1.6 mm, LeadFree HASL, 1 oz, via covering *Tented*, "Mark on PCB": default (no order number since May 2026). The C-shaped slot around the SHT40 (bottom right) is intended (heat isolation): confirm if JLC asks |
| 2 Assembly | **Economic**, top side, 2 boards, **Tooling holes: Added by Customer** (TH1–TH3 are on the board), *Confirm Parts Placement* = yes |
| 3 Files | Upload BOM + CPL. Parts list: all 45 lines must match by LCSC number (0 "no part selected") |
| 4 THT | The clamps, the 3 sockets and the fan header are THT: keep them ticked → JLC solders them (wave / hand soldering fee ≈ $3.5 + $0.02 per joint, ≈ 92 joints per board) |
| 5 Preview | Compare the placement preview with **`pin1-check.png`**: U1–U5, Q1–Q7, D1–D7, LED1, C1, C3, C13 and the clamps (wire entry towards the board edge, J3/J4/J15 pin 1 at the top). Rotate in the preview if one differs |
| 6 Price | ≈ 30 "extended" part types (≈ $3 loading fee each, once per order) — normal for a board like this |

Out of stock? SHT40 → SHT40-AD1B-R3 (C2848306) / SHT41-AD1B-R2 (C7461861). F3 → any 1206 PTC 200 mA ≥ 24 V (e.g. C2892415). F4 → any 1206 PTC 1–1.5 A ≥ 16 V (e.g. C883131); **not** the 6 V ASMD1206-150 of F2. KF250 clamp → same footprint family DG250-3.5 / WJ250-3.5 (check the drawing: Ø1.2 holes, 3.5 mm pitch, single row), or leave that line out and hand-solder.

## Parts to buy separately
| Part | Qty | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| ESP32 DevKitC V4, **WROOM** (not WROVER: GPIO16/17 are used), board 1.1 in (28 mm) or 1.0 in (25.4 mm) wide – not the narrow 0.9 in clone | 1 | Plugs into J3 + J4 (25.4 mm rows) or J3 + J15 (22.86 mm) |
| Light barrier pair, 12–24 V DC, through-beam, **NPN**, **Light-ON** (often sold as "NC"), e.g. Omron E3Z-T61 set to L-ON. Dark-ON ("NO", e.g. E3F-5DN1) works too → `beam_inverted: "false"` | 1 | BEAM clamp |
| Leak probe: 2 stainless screws / bare wire ends 5–10 mm apart on the cabinet floor, or a "water leak sensor cable" (2 wires) | 1 | LEAK clamp |
| Water valve 12 V DC, ≤ 1.5 A, that **closes when powered** (normally-open solenoid or motorised ball valve "NO") | 1 | VALVE clamp (optional) |
| VL53L1X module | 1 | I2C clamp (optional) |
| USB-C panel-mount extension (flange, 2× M3 18 mm apart, 15–30 cm) | 1 | Case back wall → DevKit USB-C: flash with the lid on |

## Wiring
| Clamp | Pins (from the board edge) | Connect |
|---|---|---|
| 12 V IN | +12V, GND | GST36E12 plug → DC-jack adapter → 2 wires |
| ACTUATOR | M+, M− | Actuator. Door moves the wrong way → swap the 2 wires |
| FAN | 4-pin header | ARCTIC P12 Slim PWM plug |
| LED | 5V, DAT, GND | WS2812B strip / ring (DIN) |
| BUTTON | BTN, GND, 12V, LED− | Alu button: NO, C, LED+, LED− |
| REEDS | CL/GND, OP/GND, DR/GND | Door closed, door open, drawer reed |
| BEAM (left) | RX+, RX−, SIG, TX+, TX−, GND | Receiver: brown, blue, black. Emitter: brown, blue. Beam across the cabinet front, ≈ 12 cm in front of the door, ≈ 2 cm above the floor |
| LEAK (left) | SENSE, GND | 2 electrodes, no polarity. Dry = 3.3 V, water < ≈ 2 V (`leak_threshold`) |
| VALVE (left) | +12V, SW | Valve + → +12V, valve − → SW (low side, flyback diode on board) |
| I2C ToF | 3V3, SDA, SCL, GND | VL53L1X module (optional) |

**Clamps:** push the button with a 2.5 mm screwdriver, insert the stripped wire (6–7 mm, 0.2–0.75 mm², ferrules OK) at 45° from the board edge, release.

## Pins (ESP32)
| GPIO | Function |
|---|---|
| 25 / 26 | DRV8871 IN1 (open) / IN2 (close) |
| 32 / 33 / 18 | Reed door closed / door open / drawer |
| 19 | Clean button |
| 23 | Button ring (AO3400A, 12 V) |
| 16 | WS2812 data (74AHCT1G125 → 330 Ω) |
| 17 / 27 | Fan PWM (2N7002, inverted) / fan tach |
| 21 / 22 | I²C SDA / SCL (INA219 0x40 + SHT40 0x44 on board, VL53L1X on the clamp) |
| 34 | Light barrier input (via 2N7002, 12 V safe) |
| 13 | Light barrier emitter on/off (AO3400A) |
| 4 / 35 | Leak probe drive (pulsed) / leak ADC (BAT54S clamp) |
| 2 | Valve (AO3400A low side, 10 k pull-down: off at boot) |
| 15 | Buzzer (AO3400A, 10 k pull-down: off at boot) |
| 36 (VP) | 12 V rail ADC (100k / 22k, BAT54S clamp) |
| 14, 5, 39 (VN) | Spare on the EXP header J11 (not assembled); 39 = input only |

## Sensors, safety, alarms
| Item | How it works |
|---|---|
| Leak | Every 10 s IO4 drives 3.3 V through 100 k for 70 ms, IO35 reads the probe (dry ≈ 3.1 V). 3 wet readings in a row (25 s) → "Water leak" on, valve powered, red strobe, beep. Water gone → LED off after 60 s; **the valve stays powered until you switch it off in HA**. Tap water between two screws 5–10 mm apart reads well below 1 V; only very clean water (< 200 kΩ needed) could stay above the 2.2 V threshold → raise `leak_threshold` to 2.8 then. |
| Valve | Use a valve that closes when powered: a cut wire or a dead PSU cannot shut the water, but a leak does. F4 (1.5 A / 16 V PTC) protects the output. |
| Buzzer | Alerts in ESPHome via `rtttl.play`. "Buzzer" switch off → everything except the leak alarm is silent. |
| 12 V rail | "12 V rail" sensor (±0.3 V) and "Supply voltage low" when it sags below `supply_low` (weak PSU, stalled actuator). |
| SHT40 | Own island + vented case chamber → cabinet air. Set `offset` in the YAML after a check. Humidity can read low for 1–2 days after soldering. |
| Auto vent | Fan on above 65 %RH / 30 °C (HA numbers), 30–100 % speed; off 5 %RH / 1 °C below, and while the drawer is out. |
| Light barrier | Door does not close while the beam is blocked; broken while closing → stop + reopen. Self-test before every close and every 10 min (emitter off, receiver must react) → "Door beam fault". |
| Stall stop | INA219 motor current > `stall_current` (default 0.8 A) → stop. |

## Power
12 V 3 A in → PTC 2.6 A → reverse-polarity P-FET → TVS 15 V. LMR51430 buck makes 5.1 V (3 A max) for the ESP32 (via Schottky, USB can stay plugged in), the LEDs (PTC 1.5 A) and the buzzer. Light barrier: 12 V via PTC 200 mA (F3). Valve: 12 V via PTC 1.5 A (F4).
Worst case ≈ 2.5 A from the adapter with the valve on. Keep LED brightness low (full white on all LEDs heats the buck).

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| LED clamp | 1.5 A (PTC) ≈ 25 LEDs at full white; 16 LEDs are fine |
| BEAM clamp | 200 mA (PTC) for receiver + emitter (typ. 30–50 mA) |
| VALVE clamp | 1.5 A (PTC), 12 V, inductive loads OK (SS34) |
| Actuator | DRV8871 limits at ≈ 1.9 A (R5 = 33 kΩ) |
| Clamps | 5 A, 0.2–0.75 mm² |

files.text:
# ESPHome config for the Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.2 (ESP32 DevKitC V4 plugged in)
# v1.1: SHT40 cabinet temperature / humidity (auto vent), door light barrier with self-test.
# v1.2: water leak probe (LEAK clamp), buzzer, 12 V valve output (VALVE clamp), 12 V rail monitor on the ADC.
# Pin changes vs. the module build: DRV8871 instead of BTS7960 (no EN pin), INA219 on the board,
# fan tach on GPIO27, external pull-ups on reeds / button (internal pull-ups stay on, harmless).
substitutions:
  stall_current: "0.8"   # A: set ~0.3 A above the running current you see in HA ("Door motor current")
  beam_inverted: "true"  # NPN Light-ON receiver (recommended, often sold as "NC") = true; Dark-ON ("NO") = false.
                         # Check: beam clear -> HA "Door beam" must show "Clear". If not, flip this value.
  leak_threshold: "2.2"  # V at the probe: dry = 3.3 V, tap water between the electrodes < ~2 V (see "Leak probe")
  supply_low: "10.5"     # V: below this the 12 V supply is sagging (weak PSU, stalled actuator)

esphome:
  name: robo-garage
  friendly_name: Robo-Garage

esp32:
  board: esp32dev
  framework:
    type: esp-idf

logger:
api:
ota:
  - platform: esphome
wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password

i2c:
  sda: GPIO21          # pull-ups 4.7k on the PCB
  scl: GPIO22
  frequency: 100kHz

globals:
  - {id: beam_testing, type: bool, initial_value: "false"}   # emitter is off for the self-test
  - {id: beam_dark_ok, type: bool, initial_value: "true"}    # last self-test: receiver saw "no light"

output:
  - {platform: gpio, pin: GPIO4, id: leak_drive}              # v1.2: IO4 -> R40 100k -> leak probe (pulsed)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: {number: GPIO15, ignore_strapping_warning: true}, id: buzzer_pwm}  # v1.2: buzzer, R46 pull-down
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO25, id: door_open_out}          # DRV8871 IN1 -> actuator extends
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO26, id: door_close_out}         # DRV8871 IN2 -> actuator retracts
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO23, id: btn_ring_out}           # AO3400A -> button ring (12 V)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO17, id: fan_pwm, frequency: 25000Hz, inverted: true}  # 2N7002 open drain

rtttl:
  id: buzzer
  output: buzzer_pwm

switch:
  - platform: gpio                                             # v1.2: AO3400A low side -> VALVE clamp (12 V, <= 1.5 A)
    id: valve                                                  # on = valve powered. Use a valve that CLOSES when
    name: "Water valve"                                        # powered (normally-open solenoid / motorised valve),
    pin: {number: GPIO2, ignore_strapping_warning: true}        # then a leak powers it and the water is off. R43 pull-down.
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_OFF
    icon: mdi:valve
  - platform: template
    id: buzzer_enabled
    name: "Buzzer"                                             # off = silent (the leak alarm still beeps)
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON
    entity_category: config
  - platform: gpio                                             # AO3400A -> light barrier emitter (TX-)
    id: beam_tx
    pin: GPIO13
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON
    internal: true
  - platform: template
    id: vent_auto
    name: "Vent auto"                                          # off = fan only from HA / manual
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON
    entity_category: config
    on_turn_off:
      - fan.turn_off: rear_fan

number:
  - platform: template
    id: vent_hum_on
    name: "Vent humidity limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "%"
    min_value: 40
    max_value: 90
    step: 1
    initial_value: 65
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config
  - platform: template
    id: vent_temp_on
    name: "Vent temperature limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "°C"
    min_value: 20
    max_value: 45
    step: 0.5
    initial_value: 30
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config

binary_sensor:
  - platform: template                                         # v1.2: LEAK clamp (probe on the cabinet floor)
    id: leak
    name: "Water leak"
    device_class: moisture
    lambda: |-
      if (std::isnan(id(leak_v).state)) return {};
      return id(leak_v).state < ${leak_threshold};
    filters: [delayed_on: 25s, delayed_off: 60s]               # 3 readings in a row (one every 10 s)
    on_press:
      - logger.log: "WATER LEAK -> valve powered, alarm"
      - switch.turn_on: valve
      - light.turn_on: {id: status_led, red: 100%, green: 0%, blue: 0%, effect: "Error strobe"}
      - rtttl.play: "leak:d=4,o=7,b=140:e,p,e,p,e,p,e,p,e,p,e"
    on_release:
      - light.turn_off: status_led                             # the valve stays powered until you switch it off in HA
  - platform: template                                         # v1.2: 12 V rail sagging (ADC on GPIO36)
    name: "Supply voltage low"
    device_class: problem
    lambda: return id(supply_v).state < ${supply_low};
    filters: [delayed_on: 2s, delayed_off: 5s]
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_closed_reed, name: "Door closed", pin: {number: GPIO32, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_open_reed, name: "Door open", pin: {number: GPIO33, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: drawer_reed, name: "Drawer", device_class: opening,
     pin: {number: GPIO18, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: false}}            # on = drawer out
  - {platform: gpio, name: "Clean button", pin: {number: GPIO19, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true},
     filters: [delayed_on: 30ms]}
  - platform: template                                         # stall stop (INA219 on the PCB)
    id: door_stall
    name: "Door stall"
    lambda: return id(motor_current).state > ${stall_current};
    filters: [delayed_on: 400ms]                               # ignores the start-up inrush
    on_press:
      - cover.stop: door
      - logger.log: "Door stall -> stopped"
  # ---- light barrier (BEAM clamp): IO34 low = SIG high = receiver output off ----
  - platform: gpio
    id: beam_raw
    internal: true
    pin: {number: GPIO34, inverted: "${beam_inverted}"}       # input-only pin, pull-up R36 on the PCB
    filters: [delayed_on_off: 5ms]
    on_press:                                                  # unfiltered edge: beam broken while closing
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return !id(beam_testing) && id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_CLOSING;'
          then:
            - logger.log: "Beam blocked while closing -> reopen"
            - cover.stop: door
            - delay: 300ms
            - cover.open: door
  - platform: template
    id: beam
    name: "Door beam"                                          # on = something in the door opening (HA display)
    device_class: occupancy
    lambda: |-
      if (id(beam_testing)) return {};                         // self-test running: keep the last state
      return id(beam_raw).state;
    filters: [delayed_off: 300ms]
  - platform: template
    id: beam_fault
    name: "Door beam fault"                                    # on = receiver did not react to the emitter
    device_class: problem

script:
  - id: beep_move                                              # 3 short beeps before the door moves
    mode: single
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_on: buzzer_enabled
          then:
            - rtttl.play: "move:d=16,o=7,b=200:e,p,e,p,e"
  - id: beam_selftest                                          # emitter off -> receiver must report "no light"
    mode: single
    then:
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = true;'
      - switch.turn_off: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # receiver must drop out (max 0.5 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_on: beam_raw
          timeout: 500ms
      - lambda: 'id(beam_dark_ok) = id(beam_raw).state;'
      - switch.turn_on: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # and see the beam again (max 1 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_off: beam_raw
          timeout: 1s
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = false;'
      - binary_sensor.template.publish:
          id: beam_fault
          state: !lambda 'return !id(beam_dark_ok);'

sensor:
  - platform: adc                                              # v1.2: leak probe, read only while IO4 drives it
    id: leak_v
    name: "Leak probe"
    pin: GPIO35
    attenuation: 12db
    update_interval: never
    unit_of_measurement: V
    accuracy_decimals: 2
    entity_category: diagnostic
  - platform: adc                                              # v1.2: 100k / 22k divider on the 12 V rail
    id: supply_v
    name: "12 V rail"
    pin: GPIO36
    attenuation: 12db
    update_interval: 1s
    filters: [multiply: 5.545, sliding_window_moving_average: {window_size: 5, send_every: 5}]
    accuracy_decimals: 1
    unit_of_measurement: V
  - platform: ina219                                           # on the PCB, shunt 0.1 ohm
    address: 0x40
    shunt_resistance: 0.1 ohm
    max_voltage: 16V
    max_current: 3.2A
    update_interval: 100ms
    current:
      name: "Door motor current"
      id: motor_current
    bus_voltage:
      name: "12 V supply"
  - platform: sht4x                                            # SHT40 on the PCB island
    address: 0x44
    update_interval: 30s
    temperature:
      name: "Cabinet temperature"
      id: cab_temp
      filters: [offset: 0.0]                                   # set after a check with a reference thermometer
    humidity:
      name: "Cabinet humidity"
      id: cab_hum
  - platform: pulse_counter                                    # fan tach, 2 pulses per turn
    pin: {number: GPIO27, mode: INPUT_PULLUP}
    name: "Rear fan speed"
    unit_of_measurement: rpm
    filters: [multiply: 0.5]
    update_interval: 10s

fan:
  - {platform: speed, id: rear_fan, output: fan_pwm, name: "Rear fan"}

interval:
  - interval: 10s                                              # v1.2: leak probe, 70 ms of 3.3 V every 10 s (no corrosion)
    then:
      - output.turn_on: leak_drive
      - delay: 50ms
      - component.update: leak_v
      - delay: 20ms
      - output.turn_off: leak_drive
  - interval: 30s                                              # auto vent from the SHT40
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_on: vent_auto
          then:
            - lambda: |-
                if (id(drawer_reed).state) {                       // drawer out: no fan while you work at the station
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                const float h = id(cab_hum).state, t = id(cab_temp).state;
                if (std::isnan(h) || std::isnan(t)) return;
                const float h_on = id(vent_hum_on).state, t_on = id(vent_temp_on).state;
                static bool running = false;
                if (h > h_on || t > t_on) running = true;
                else if (h < h_on - 5.0f && t < t_on - 1.0f) running = false;   // 5 %RH / 1 degC hysteresis
                if (!running) {
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                // 30 % at the switch-off point, 100 % at limit + 15 %RH or + 6 degC, in 10 % steps
                const float x = std::max((h - h_on + 5.0f) / 20.0f, (t - t_on + 1.0f) / 7.0f);
                const float s = 30.0f + 70.0f * std::min(std::max(x, 0.0f), 1.0f);
                const int speed = 10 * (int) roundf(s / 10.0f);
                if (!id(rear_fan).state || id(rear_fan).speed != speed)
                  id(rear_fan).turn_on().set_speed(speed).perform();
  - interval: 10min                                            # beam self-test while the door is idle
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_IDLE;'
          then:
            - script.execute: beam_selftest

cover:
  - platform: endstop
    id: door
    name: "Robo-Garage Door"
    device_class: garage
    open_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out
      - script.execute: beep_move
      - output.turn_on: door_open_out
    open_endstop: door_open_reed
    open_duration: 11s
    close_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - script.execute: beep_move
      - script.execute: beam_selftest                          # 0.1-1.5 s before every close
      - script.wait: beam_selftest
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(beam_dark_ok) && !id(beam_raw).state;'   # sensor works and beam is clear
          then:
            - output.turn_on: door_close_out
          else:
            - logger.log: "Door stays open: beam blocked or beam fault"
            - cover.open: door                                 # back to fully open (no-op if already open)
    close_endstop: door_closed_reed
    close_duration: 11s
    max_duration: 15s
    stop_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out

light:
  - {platform: monochromatic, name: "Clean button ring", output: btn_ring_out}
  - platform: esp32_rmt_led_strip
    id: status_led
    name: "Robo-Garage Status LED"
